messages.subject: Project Quartz — terms agreed
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Good news - we've reached agreement with Brandt on the licence. Final economics: £1.25m upfront, 5.0% running royalty, minimum annual royalties of £150k/£350k/£500k, exclusive in the compostable flexible-packaging field across the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, and a liability cap of £3m (fees paid in the preceding 12 months). The Verdant carve-out and a year-two Japan review go in the side letter. We'll finalise execution copies and aim to complete on 12 December. You'll need a board resolution approving the licence and side letter.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
